description: Parameter registry for the attention-level blocks of the affinity-ranking model. Gating/activation units are referenced by name from gating_activation_params.json for unified management. Plan v4 (antigen-conditioned, update_architecture.txt): residual_geglu_adapter / preln_cross_attention / attn_pool / bilinear_gate_fusion / head_v4. Plan v3 blocks kept for ablation. See preparation/plan-v4.md v4.

adapter_antiberty.used_in: Plan v4 antibody tower adapter: AntiBERTy 512 -> 256 (Linear -> LN -> GEGLU-FFN + residual)

adapter_esm2.used_in: Plan v4 antigen tower adapter: ESM-2 1280 -> 256 (same parameterization as adapter_antiberty)

interaction_ag_ab.used_in: Plan v4 interaction: P_ag' = P_ag + Drop(CrossAttn(Q=LN(P_ag), KV=LN(P_ab))); antigen-as-query

attn_pool_256.used_in: Plan v4: A_pool = AttnPool(P_ag'), B_pool = AttnPool(P_ab)

bilinear_gate_256.used_in: Plan v4 fusion: gate = sigmoid(W(LN(A_pool) (*) LN(B_pool))); F = gate*A + (1-gate)*B

head_v4.used_in: Plan v4 scoring head: F -> 64 -> GELU -> Dropout -> 1 (bypass_dim=2 arm keeps the IgLM nll bypass as ablation)

adapter_iglm.used_in: IgLM stream adapter: 512 -> 256 (Plan v3, kept for A1 ablation)

gated_cross_attention.used_in: Plan v3 fusion arm (kept for ablation): zero-init tanh-gated cross-attention

gated_residual_fusion.used_in: Plan v3 fusion arm (kept for ablation): cheapest gated linear injection

affinity_head.used_in: Plan v3 MLP scoring head; bypass = [log ppl_iglm, log ppl_progen]
